# OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company known for the GPT series of
language models and the ChatGPT product, which brought large language models
to mainstream attention.

## Key Products

- **GPT-4**: Multimodal large language model
- **ChatGPT**: Conversational AI product
- **DALL-E**: Text-to-image generation
- **Whisper**: Speech recognition model
